clips.send: A parent sends this to whoever buys "diet" everything for the kids - anger at realizing "diet" just means a different chemical.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau's label trick: corn doesn't always say "corn." On a food label it can hide as corn syrup solids, high fructose corn syrup, corn starch, corn meal, or corn flour - five names for the same thing.

His next target: diet soda. The two sweeteners behind almost every "diet" drink are aspartame and sucralose, both sold as a way to cut calories.

Kevin's real claim isn't about taste. It's that the main reason people reach for them, he says, is because they've been lied to about what "diet" actually means.

Which name are you really looking for on the label?

#kevintrudeau #readthelabel #dietsoda #wbdaily #healthtruth #realfood
